summary.text: Zach Dorholt is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 14B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Sue Ek.
He previously represented District 14B from 2013 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Zach Dorholt won the 2012 election for Minnesota House District 14B, defeating incumbent Republican King Banaian in the general election on November 6, 2012.
In the 2013 legislative session he served on the Government Operations, Higher Education Finance and Policy (as vice chair), and Transportation Policy committees.
Jim Knoblach defeated Dorholt in the 2014 general election, 50.2% to 49.5%, and again in 2016, 51.33% to 48.67%.
